without.basis: docs/non-alcoholic.md, Terms and thresholds: 0.5 % is the line of EU de-alcoholised wine, UK de-alcoholised and US malt non-alcoholic; 'below' follows the US wording. Which preset is the default needs the owner's decision.
docs/non-alcoholic.md: the UK guidance line for 'alcohol free' (no more than 0.05 % ABV), as quoted in the 2023 consultation paper.
docs/non-alcoholic.md: no alcohol at all, the US condition for 'alcohol free' and '0.0 percent' (27 CFR 7.65).

low.basis: docs/non-alcoholic.md: the UK 'low alcohol' line (1.2 % ABV or below), as quoted by gov.uk.
docs/non-alcoholic.md: the bar sense of low ABV (a vermouth or sherry drink); no source read defines low ABV for a cocktail. Adjustable.
